Export a comprehensive analysis bundle from a completed AutoIML run

Source: R/export_analysis_bundle.R
export_analysis_bundle.Rd

Saves all standard gate artifact tables, auto-generated plots, and the audit bundle for any completed AutoIML run to a directory tree:

dir/
  audit_bundle/   <- export_audit_bundle() output (report card, guide, RDS)
  tables/         <- gate artifact CSVs (G1-G7)
  figures/        <- PDF+PNG pairs for each auto$plot() type
  objects/        <- full result.rds

All saves are conditional — artifacts that did not run or are absent are skipped silently. Extend with extra_tables and extra_figures for analysis-specific additions.

Usage

export_analysis_bundle(
  auto,
  dir = "analysis_bundle",
  prefix = "run",
  extra_tables = list(),
  extra_figures = list(),
  exclude_plot_types = character(),
  fig_width = 10,
  fig_height = 6
)

Arguments

auto

(AutoIML) A completed AutoIML runner.

dir

(character(1)) Root output directory (created if needed).

prefix

(character(1)) File name prefix for all outputs.

extra_tables

(list) Named list of list(dt = ..., path = ..., ...); each element is forwarded to save_analysis_table().

extra_figures

(list) Named list of list(p = ..., path = ..., ...); each element is forwarded to save_analysis_plot().

exclude_plot_types

(character()) Standard auto$plot() types to skip when exporting the default figure set.

fig_width, fig_height

(numeric(1)) Default figure dimensions in inches.

Value

Invisibly, a named list of all paths written.
